TC-12/S29.title: The Important Points window is a configuration value of 12 h (both modes)
TC-12/S29.detail: Code read at 8b4be94a: the window is 12 h in both modes (one server sweep over both tables) — value right. But it is a TypeScript const (convex/lib/importantPoints.ts:7 IMPORTANT_POINT_TTL_MS = 12 * 60 * 60 * 1000), not read from an env variable or a settings row; changing it needs a deploy. Fails UAT 3.6 'All windows are configuration values, not hard-coded' unless a named constant counts (Q12). Judged checks 2/3.
TC-12/S29.stated: UAT 3.6 'All windows are configuration values, not hard-coded'
